title: Delhi AQI Today 😷 Hawa Bani Zeher! Smog Ke 5 Shocking Facts #shorts
description:
Delhi AQI phir se 'very poor'! Delhi ki hawa bani zeher 😷
Delhi pollution aur smog season ki poori kahani 5 facts mein.

October 8 saal ka sabse saaf mahina • Baarish ke baad AQI 60, 3 din mein 307 • Diwali par AQI 376, 2021 ke baad sabse zyada • 6 Nov ko GRAP Stage 3 lagu (AQI 382) • Mundka mein PM2.5 limit se 60 guna zyada
